title: Concept: pnpm lockfile fetches a tarball over cleartext
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares a pnpm tarball URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The package crosses the network unencrypted, so its bytes can be replaced before the integrity check runs.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pnpm-lock.yaml (npm).
risk: The package crosses the network unencrypted, so its bytes can be replaced before the integrity check runs.
